annotations.translations_from: Manually authored complete STORY translations, reused by exact full-text match; not extracted by splitting apostrophes.
annotations.forms: Written present tables for all used verbs, relevant preterite/subjunctive/perfect/non-finite tables, and noun/adjective forms. Common-gender person nouns have both article rows rather than a false single-gender claim.
annotations.examples: Two manually written Spanish/English teaching examples per lexicon entry; examples are not represented as source dialogue.
annotations.pronunciation: Broad Spain-Spanish IPA, bare strings; actual production pronunciation still requires native TTS speech QA.

word_origins.basis: Specific checked primary sources, mainly RAE DLE/DPD; scholarly/official name sources. Reconstructed forms retain an asterisk; uncertain specific name histories are explicitly uncertain.

targeted_context_checks: llevar elapsed duration versus client representation
personal a versus a in poco a poco
emphatic a mí plus unstressed me refers to one person
de after más versus agency type versus tratar de; como introduces the starting role
hemos ido creciendo and written ido/non-finite forms
no gender agreement of llamado with auxiliary haber
esto follows the corroborated original source, not the small decoder's eso
